description: A custom FrameLayout subclass that enables dragging and repositioning of child views using ViewDragHelper, including a controller interface for drag events.

classes.name: DragFrameLayout
classes.description: A FrameLayout that allows child views to be draggable and repositioned via touch gestures.

methods.name: addDragView
methods.description: Adds a view to the list of draggable views.

methods.name: setDragFrameController
methods.description: Sets the controller to receive drag event callbacks.
